title: [spec-gap][R-X509-016/018/051] SAN address binding: exactly-one native 0200::/8 iPAddress == AddrForKey(SPKI)
description: spec/appendix-x509-cert-profile.md sections 4 and 8 step 4: SAN MUST be present; MUST be critical iff subject is empty; MUST contain exactly one iPAddress GeneralName ([7] primitive, 16 bytes) equal byte-for-byte to upstream AddrForKey(subjectPublicKey) in 0200::/8; a second native entry MUST NOT appear; verifiers MUST reject zero/multiple/mismatch and MUST NOT substitute the SHA-512 IID into the lower 64 bits; dNSName/rfc822Name/URI MUST NOT be used; verifiers MUST ignore any other iPAddress. Classification: not-implemented. Evidence: no SAN/X.509 leaf parsing in any stack (grep x509/iPAddress/subjectAltName hits only spec + docs/ca-lichen-tech-design.md). Building block exists+tested in all three stacks: rust/lichen-core/src/addr.rs:113 ygg_addr_from_pubkey, python/src/lichen/crypto/identity.py:209 yggdrasil_address, C lichen/subsys/lichen/link/identity_addr.c:75; pinned oracle test/vectors/yggdrasil_address.json (upstream_addr_for_key). Sibling tracked under bedw epic (x5chain parsing = bedw.8); this bead is the appendix binding checks on top. Suggested placement: python/src/lichen/crypto/cert_profile.py beside trust_anchors.py; rust/lichen-gateway/src/trust.rs chain path (or new lichen-x509 crate); C lichen/subsys/lichen cert module sharing DER helpers with bedw.8.
